description: AI visibility check for online stores on Shopify and WooCommerce: is your store showing up in AI shopping answers, with the right prices, stock and links? Read-only, with evidence and plain-language fixes. By AI Sales Assurance.

interface.longDescription: AI Visibility for Stores, by AI Sales Assurance. Is your online store showing up in AI shopping answers, and with the right price? This read-only AI visibility and AI readiness check works for ecommerce stores on Shopify (WooCommerce stores are also supported, with fewer checks). It compares what AI shopping assistants receive with your real product pages: prices, currency, stock, variants, offers and product links, and checks whether AI answers cite your store. Each finding comes with evidence and a plain-language fix. Items that cannot be tested are reported as such, never as passed or failed. The check never changes the store and never places orders. It also points store owners to practical guides in English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch and Japanese.
